senses.gloss:
a. 
(-ली f.) [बिडालस्येदम् अण्] 
__1 Relating to a cat. 
__2 Peculiar to cats. 
-Comp. 
-व्रतम् ‘a cat-like observance,’ concealing one's malice or evil designs under the garb of piety or virtue. 
-व्रतिः one who leads a chaste life simply from want of female company (and not because he has controlled his senses). 
-व्रतिकः, -व्रतिन् m. a religious hypocrite, an impostor; बैडालव्रतिकाञ्छठान् … वाङ्मात्रेणापि नार्चयेत् [[Ms. 4. 30.]]
